definitions.explanation: Going out of the house for an errand, a visit or a trip for pleasure. The friendly or polite noun from the verb 'to go out', common in family talk, shop greetings and travel and leisure ads.

examples.japanese: ⟦{週末|しゅうまつ}→週末：03030_shuumatsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧お{出|で}かけ⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: We went on an outing as a family at the weekend.

examples.japanese: ⟦{雨|あめ}→雨：00583_ame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧お{出|で}かけ⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}している→探す：00493_sagasu⟧。
examples.english: I'm looking for places to go with the kids that are fun even on rainy days.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- お{出|で}かけです⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: Off out? (a friendly greeting to a neighbor leaving home)
- お{出|で}かけ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to go out (with the family, for fun)
- お{出|で}かけ⟦スポット→スポット：11578_supotto⟧: places to go on an outing
- お{出|で}かけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧: when you go out (in notices: お{出|で}かけ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{戸締|とじ}まり→戸締まり：17821_tojimari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{出|で}かける→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧: to go out; the plain verb. お{出|で}かけ sounds softer and more cheerful, and often implies going out for fun
- ⟦{外出|がいしゅつ}→外出：02543_gaishutsu⟧: going out; the neutral, more formal noun ({外出中|がいしゅつちゅう}: out of the office)
